title: Chinese Class for Chinese Students
synopsis: Learn about how native speakers study Chinese in school.

fullText.simplified:
中国人的汉语课学什么？

    聊起汉语课，每个人都有数不清的故事可以讲，因为学汉语并不是一项很轻松的任务。那么，作为母语者，汉语课轻松吗？答案是，并不。
    在对中国人的教育里，汉语课叫语文课，主要的任务是提高阅读能力。因此，语文课的第一项任务就是教会学生们认识汉字。事实上，即使是母语者，也只需要掌握三千五百个汉字，学会这些汉字就可以满足人们百分之九十九的需要了。
    在小学一年级和二年级，学生们会学习拼音，并学会写两千多个汉字，和HSK考试最高级考试的要求一样。可以想象，对于七岁的孩子，这项任务并不简单。如果你感兴趣，可以找一些中国孩子练习写字的视频，往往非常有趣。当然，学生们也会开始学习最简单的文学，背一些诗歌。
    在进入小学三年级和四年级以后，汉字就不是主要的学习任务了。学生们会学习查字典的方法，通过阅读和查字典掌握剩下的一千多个汉字。这时，学生们就可以自己看书看报纸了。同时，可能是每个人最大的噩梦——作文开始了。
    从小学五年级一直到高中毕业，语文课的主要任务就是文学而不是语法，学生们要学习如何理解作者的写作方法和情感。从这时开始，学生们的差距开始慢慢出现，因为如果不读大量的书，很难提高阅读的速度。而高考要求学生们在两个半小时内完成一万字的阅读任务，并写出八百字以上的作文。
    也许，中国人学语文的痛苦，并不比你学汉语少。
fullText.traditional:
中國人的漢語課學什麼？

    聊起漢語課，每個人都有數不清的故事可以講，因為學漢語並不是一項很輕鬆的任務。那麼，作為母語者，漢語課輕鬆嗎？答案是，並不。
    在對中國人的教育裡，漢語課叫語文課，主要的任務是提高閱讀能力。因此，語文課的第一項任務就是教會學生們認識漢字。事實上，即使是母語者，也只需要掌握三千五百個漢字，學會這些漢字就可以滿足人們百分之九十九的需要了。
    在小學一年級和二年級，學生們會學習拼音，並學會寫兩千多個漢字，和HSK考試最高級考試的要求一樣。可以想像，對於七歲的孩子，這項任務並不簡單。如果你感興趣，可以找一些中國孩子練習寫字的視頻，往往非常有趣。當然，學生們也會開始學習最簡單的文學，背一些詩歌。
    在進入小學三年級和四年級以後，漢字就不是主要的學習任務了。學生們會學習查字典的方法，通過閱讀和查字典掌握剩下的一千多個漢字。這時，學生們就可以自己看書看報紙了。同時，可能是每個人最大的噩夢——作文開始了。
    從小學五年級一直到高中畢業，語文課的主要任務就是文學而不是語法，學生們要學習如何理解作者的寫作方法和情感。從這時開始，學生們的差距開始慢慢出現，因為如果不讀大量的書，很難提高閱讀的速度。而高考要求學生們在兩個半小時內完成一萬字的閱讀任務，並寫出八百字以上的作文。
    也許，中國人學語文的痛苦，並不比你學漢語少。

sentences.traditional: 聊起漢語課，每個人都有數不清的故事可以講，

sentences.simplified: 因为学汉语并不是一项很轻松的任务。
sentences.traditional: 因為學漢語並不是一項很輕鬆的任務。
sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi xué hàn yǔ bìng bù shì yí xiàng hěn qīng sōng de rèn wu
sentences.english: Speaking of Chinese class, every person has countless stories to tell, ..

sentences.simplified: 那么，作为母语者，汉语课轻松吗？答案是，并不。

So as a native speaker, is Chinese class easy? The answer is, not at all.

sentences.pinyin: zhǔ yào de rèn wu shì tí gāo yuè dú néng lì
sentences.english: In the Chinese education system, Chinese class is called literature and language class, ..

sentences.simplified: 因此，语文课的第一项任务就是教会学生们认识汉字。
sentences.traditional: 因此，語文課的第一項任務就是教會學生們認識漢字。

sentences.english: .. and the main task is to increase the students’ reading ability.

sentences.simplified: 事实上，即使是母语者，也只需要掌握三千五百个汉字，

sentences.english: Consequently, the first task of literature and language class is to teach students Chinese characters.

sentences.traditional: 學會這些漢字就可以滿足人們百分之九十九的需要了。

sentences.english: In fact, even though they’re native speakers, they still only need to learn 3,500 characters.
Learning these 3,500 characters can satisfy 99% of what people need.

sentences.pinyin: bìng xué huì xiě liǎng qiān duō ge hàn zì hé 3 kǎo shì zuì gāo jí kǎo shì de yāo qiú yí yàng
sentences.english: In 1st and 2nd grade of elementary school, students study pinyin, ..

sentences.simplified: 可以想象，对于七岁的孩子，这项任务并不简单。
sentences.traditional: 可以想像，對於七歲的孩子，這項任務並不簡單。

sentences.simplified: 如果你感兴趣，可以找一些中国孩子练习写字的视频，
sentences.traditional: 如果你感興趣，可以找一些中國孩子練習寫字的視頻，
sentences.pinyin: rú guǒ nǐ gǎn xìng qù kě yǐ zhǎo yì xiē zhōng guó hái zi liàn xí xiě zì de shì pín
sentences.english: As you can imagine, this is no simple task for 7-year-old children.

sentences.simplified: 往往非常有趣。
sentences.traditional: 往往非常有趣。
sentences.pinyin: wǎng wǎng fēi cháng yǒu qù
sentences.english: If you’re interested, you can search for videos of Chinese children practice writing characters.

sentences.simplified: 当然，学生们也会开始学习最简单的文学，背一些诗歌。
sentences.traditional: 當然，學生們也會開始學習最簡單的文學，背一些詩歌。

sentences.english: They are often very interesting.
Of course, students will also start studying the easiest literature, and learn some poems by heart.

sentences.simplified: 在进入小学三年级和四年级以后，汉字就不是主要的学习任务了。
sentences.traditional: 在進入小學三年級和四年級以後，漢字就不是主要的學習任務了。
sentences.pinyin: zài jìn rù xiǎo xué sān nián jí hé sì nián jí yǐ hòu hàn zì jiù bú shì zhǔ yào de xué xí rèn wu le

sentences.simplified: 学生们会学习查字典的方法，
sentences.traditional: 學生們會學習查字典的方法，
sentences.pinyin: xué sheng men huì xué xí chá zì diǎn de fāng fǎ
sentences.english: After they enter 3rd and 4th grade of elementary school, studying characters is no longer the main task.

sentences.simplified: 通过阅读和查字典掌握剩下的一千多个汉字。
sentences.traditional: 通過閱讀和查字典掌握剩下的一千多個漢字。
sentences.pinyin: tōng guò yuè dú hé chá zì diǎn zhǎng wò shèng xià de yì qiān duō ge hàn zì
sentences.english: Students will learn the methods of looking up characters in a dictionary, ..

sentences.simplified: 这时，学生们就可以自己看书看报纸了。
sentences.traditional: 這時，學生們就可以自己看書看報紙了。
sentences.pinyin: zhè shí xué sheng men jiù kě yǐ zì jǐ kàn shū kàn bào zhǐ le
sentences.english: .. and learn the over 1,000 remaining characters through reading and looking up in a dictionary.

sentences.simplified: 同时，可能是每个人最大的噩梦——作文开始了。
sentences.traditional: 同時，可能是每個人最大的噩夢——作文開始了。
sentences.pinyin: tóng shí kě néng shì měi ge rén zuì dà de è mèng zuò wén kāi shǐ le
sentences.english: By this time, students can read books and newspapers by themselves.
At the same time, this may be everyone’s biggest nightmare – they start writing essays.

sentences.simplified: 从小学五年级一直到高中毕业，
sentences.traditional: 從小學五年級一直到高中畢業，
sentences.pinyin: cóng xiǎo xué wǔ nián jí yì zhí dào gāo zhōng bì yè

sentences.simplified: 语文课的主要任务就是文学而不是语法，

sentences.pinyin: yǔ wén kè de zhǔ yào rèn wu jiù shì wén xué ér bú shì yǔ fǎ
sentences.english: From 5th grade of elementary school until graduation from high school, ..

sentences.simplified: 学生们要学习如何理解作者的写作方法和情感。
sentences.traditional: 學生們要學習如何理解作者的寫作方法和情感。
sentences.pinyin: xué sheng men yào xué xí rú hé lǐ jiě zuò zhě de xiě zuò fāng fǎ hé qíng gǎn
sentences.english: .. the main task of literature and language class is to study literature, not grammar.

sentences.simplified: 从这时开始，学生们的差距开始慢慢出现，

sentences.english: The students need to learn how to understand the author’s way of writing and evoking feelings.

sentences.simplified: 因为如果不读大量的书，很难提高阅读的速度。
sentences.traditional: 因為如果不讀大量的書，很難提高閱讀的速度。
sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi rú guǒ bù dú dà liàng de shū hěn nán tí gāo yuè dú de sù dù
sentences.english: From this moment forward, gaps gradually start to appear between the students, ..

sentences.simplified: 而高考要求学生们在两个半小时内
sentences.traditional: 而高考要求學生們在兩個半小時內
sentences.pinyin: ér gāo kǎo yāo qiú xué sheng men zài liǎng ge bàn xiǎo shí nèi
sentences.english: .. because if they don’t read a large number of books, it’s very difficult to increase reading speed.

sentences.simplified: 完成一万字的阅读任务，并写出八百字以上的作文。
sentences.traditional: 完成一萬字的閱讀任務，並寫出八百字以上的作文。
sentences.pinyin: wán chéng yí wàn zì de yuè dú rèn wu bìng xiě chū bā bǎi zì yǐ shàng de zuò wén
sentences.english: And the college entrance exam requires students to, within two and a half hours, ..
.. complete a 10,000 character reading assignment, and write an essay of 800 or more characters.

sentences.simplified: 也许，中国人学语文的痛苦，并不比你学汉语少。
sentences.traditional: 也許，中國人學語文的痛苦，並不比你學漢語少。
sentences.pinyin: yě xǔ zhōng guó rén xué yǔ wén de tòng kǔ bìng bù bǐ nǐ xué hàn yǔ shǎo

sentences.english: Perhaps, Chinese people suffer no less when studying literature and language, than you do when studying Chinese.

Speaking of Chinese class, every person has countless stories to tell, ..

So as a native speaker, is Chinese class easy? The answer is, not at all.
In the Chinese education system, Chinese class is called literature and language class, ..
.. and the main task is to increase the students’ reading ability.
Consequently, the first task of literature and language class is to teach students Chinese characters.
In fact, even though they’re native speakers, they still only need to learn 3,500 characters.
Learning these 3,500 characters can satisfy 99% of what people need.
In 1st and 2nd grade of elementary school, students study pinyin, ..
.. and learn to write over 2,000 characters, the same requirement as the most advanced HSK exam.
As you can imagine, this is no simple task for 7-year-old children.
If you’re interested, you can search for videos of Chinese children practice writing characters.
They are often very interesting.
Of course, students will also start studying the easiest literature, and learn some poems by heart.
After they enter 3rd and 4th grade of elementary school, studying characters is no longer the main task.
Students will learn the methods of looking up characters in a dictionary, ..
.. and learn the over 1,000 remaining characters through reading and looking up in a dictionary.
By this time, students can read books and newspapers by themselves.
At the same time, this may be everyone’s biggest nightmare – they start writing essays.
From 5th grade of elementary school until graduation from high school, ..
.. the main task of literature and language class is to study literature, not grammar.
The students need to learn how to understand the author’s way of writing and evoking feelings.
From this moment forward, gaps gradually start to appear between the students, ..
.. because if they don’t read a large number of books, it’s very difficult to increase reading speed.
And the college entrance exam requires students to, within two and a half hours, ..
.. complete a 10,000 character reading assignment, and write an essay of 800 or more characters.
Perhaps, Chinese people suffer no less when studying literature and language, than you do when studying Chinese.
